generations.name: First generation (V297)
generations.notes: Launch on EVA2, 400 V: 120 kWh gross / 107.8 kWh usable (Mercedes US quotes 108.4), up to 200 kW DC. AMG EQS is a variant. Confidence: high (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mercedes-Benz_EQS

generations.name: 2025 update (118 kWh pack)
generations.notes: New 118 kWh usable pack on all trims, DC still 200 kW. Confidence: high (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://media.mbusa.com/releases/mercedes-benz-eqs-sedan-introduces-extensive-updates-for-2025 ; https://www.cars.com/articles/2025-mercedes-benz-eqs-gets-larger-battery-updated-nose-481072

generations.name: 2027 update (800 V)
generations.notes: Second facelift: 800 V architecture, larger pack (122 kWh reported for Europe), up to 350 kW DC; US trims 450+, 500 4MATIC, 580 4MATIC. Confidence: medium (researched 2026-11-19, owner review pending). Sources: https://insideevs.com/news/792767/mercedes-eqs-facelift-800-volt/ ; https://www.cars.com/articles/mercedes-latest-redesigned-ev-has-3-significant-changes-523516/ ; https://www.mbusa.com/en/future-vehicles/2027-mercedes-benz-eqs-sedan
